entries.what: User caught: ForgeFalchion texture quality is poor ON THE MESH ('mesh looks great, texture is not'). Agent had graded the flat atlas image + a distant in-arena capture only — never a close-up of the applied texture. ROOT CAUSE: rig_weapon's AO-bake sizing clamped canvas aspect with min(1.0, aspect), squaring every tall canvas — the 5.37 layout baked 1024x1024, so on-mesh texels stretched ~5.4x along the blade.
entries.residue: (a) CODE: bake sizing fixed (long side 1024, short side by uv_aspect; height:width semantics documented) — every future conveyor asset inherits it. (b) GATE: close-up texture grade (inspection-range capture + explicit criteria: no anisotropic smear, features legible, materials differentiated) is now a mandatory conveyor step BEFORE save_mesh — atlas-as-image grading is insufficient by doctrine. (c) Durable assets re-uploaded: mesh 103528640483692 + texture 74226553172942; the smeared pair 103390730043911/72913711270849 is ORPHANED (mesh-ledger follow-up).
